updates.title: Blocks that shrink for real
updates.text: The Size changer option in the Map Editor now shrinks the block's hitbox too, so a shrunk block really lets players through. Choose how small it gets with Smallest size.

updates.title: Clans
updates.text: Create or join a clan on the new Clans page. Your clan tag shows next to your name in the game, clans have leaders and officers, join requests, a member list and points from their members' scores.
